name: When does bathroom marble need to be replaced instead of restored?

mainEntity.name: When does bathroom marble need to be replaced instead of restored?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need replacement or remediation when marble experiences persistent cracking, deep hollow sounds underfoot, or chronic water intrusion behind shower walls. Superficial surface dullness, minor scratches, and light etching do not require replacement; professional stone restoration can hone and polish the marble back to life. However, if tiles loosen, grout disintegrates due to subfloor flex, or persistent moisture leaks occur behind the wall, the stone must be removed to fix underlying structural and waterproofing problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Surface scratches and etching can be restored by polishing. You must replace marble if tiles crack from subfloor movement, loosen, or allow water intrusion behind walls.
